feature: ADR-0092 single cold reload preparation job and actual actor delivery
dependencies: Existing local keyweave-progress promoted from dev to production; Cargo.lock unchanged; no external dependency/FFI/unsafe changes.

windows.scope: New nine portable and previous shared/native changes still need pinned x64/i686 validation; previous automatic approval quota failure remains.

limitations: One job or ready result per retained owner, not a global bound on caller-created owners.
No join while running, but scheduling/thread creation/allocator/completed join cleanup have no hard time bound.
Close cannot preempt compile; keep same owner to reap. Drop detaches unfinished thread, not a termination proof.
Caller must close receiver at Stop and independently check lease/session/time before each operation; no progress or lease renewal from preparation.

Sealed Engine/Linux Runtime/Windows SessionActor delivery checks exact pending request and actual base before activation. Linux Runtime trait compiled only; Windows actor uses a no-output mock on Linux.
Receiver waits for exact AckSent before next transaction; commit before failed ack is preserved without rollback/retry.
Native reload endpoints, worker control loop and CaptureSession borrow adapter, watcher, reload CLI not connected.
New tests only owned background threads, pure engine and shared mock actor; no files, native input/output, suspend or drivers.
Full original cross-platform objective remains unfinished.
